title: Shared definitions for townsfolk protocol v1

v.description: Protocol major version. Any other value gets HTTP 400.

name.description: Save ids and NPC names become file names, so the alphabet is closed and a leading dot is refused.

farmerId.description: The decimal form of the game's Farmer.UniqueMultiplayerID. Each farmer has their own memory section with every NPC. A request with no farmerId is from the single-player main farmer (the host, once a world request has named it).

farmerName.description: The farmer's display name. Sent with farmerId, never alone.

talkFact.description: Something the NPC will remember from a picked reply, for example a promise. It reaches that NPC's memory and the town facts only when the day is saved. shareable false means told in confidence: never passed on as gossip.

eventsSeen.description: Ids of the game's scripted events the player has seen (Game1.player.eventsSeen), sent unfiltered. The brain keeps, per NPC, only the cast heart events that NPC took part in or was present for (brain/src/story.ts). Optional, default empty.
